test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In August 2022, the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment launched the ________ scheme, with an aim to provide comprehensive rehabilitation services to people engaged in begging in 75 municipalities.
solution:
The correct answer is __**SMILE-75**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

SMILE-75 Initiative:

__
 
• Under the “SMILE-75” Initiative, 75 Municipal Corporations will undertake comprehensive rehabilitation of persons engaged in the act of begging in the spirit of Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav.
 
• Municipal Corporations, in collaboration with NGOs and other stakeholders, will cover several comprehensive welfare measures for persons who are engaged in the act of begging, with a focus extensively on rehabilitation, provision of medical facilities, counselling, awareness, education, skill development, economic linkages and convergence with other Government welfare programmes etc.
 
• The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment has also allocated a total budget of Rs.100 crore for the SMILE project for the coming years till 2025-26.
 
• It seeks to develop a support mechanism for the holistic rehabilitation of those engaged in the act of begging.
 
• Implementing Ministry: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
 
• It includes the sub-scheme of Comprehensive Rehabilitation of persons engaged in the act of Begging.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• About Project "SMILE":

 
 
• SMILE: Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise.
 
• It is a new umbrella scheme that aims to provide welfare measures to the Transgender community and the people engaged in the act of begging.
 
• It was launched by the Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment on 12 August 2022.
 
• The Ministry has allocated Rs. 365 Crore for the scheme from 2021-22 to 2025-26.
 
• The Housing facility in the form of ‘Garima Greh’ ensures food, clothing, recreational facilities, skill development opportunities, recreational activities medical support, etc. to the Transgender community and the people engaged in the act of begging.
 
• The focus of the scheme is extensively on rehabilitation, provision of medical facilities, counseling, basic documentation, education, skill development, economic linkages, and so on.
 
• It is estimated that approximately 60,000 poorest persons would be benefited under this scheme for leading a life of dignity.
